NewsArticle.Title: Update
NewsArticle.Content: Dark Ages server updated this morning, bringing these new improvements: Restricted Areas: Restricted areas keep out people that are thrown into the area. Rare items: If you are registered, no matter what insight you are, you may pick up a rare item. One must be registered to pick up a rare item. Higher insights are required to wear some rare items. And other internal changes for superior stability. As before: Portrait: If you are registered, no matter what insight you are, you may upload your portrait that you created. [Portrait screenshot.](http://www.darkages.com/2000/play/s_portrait.html) Shout: If you are registered, you may shout, no matter what insight you are, which may be heard at twice the distance of speech.
